prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone square transparent mineral overlay on a LOGICAL 16x16 Minecraft pixel grid.
Primary request: Black Shale, variant 1, FRAGMENT role. One short steep oblique fissility film near one side, about 2 logical cells thick in the middle and 5 to 7 cells long, interrupted by one clear notch, tapering before midface. No second parallel band. Deposit identity: organic-rich shale fissility with sulfide enrichment. Only an incidental short physical window into the deposit; a tiled patch carries the overall identity.
Scene/backdrop: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero wherever no mineral. No stone, deepslate, matte, checkerboard, or panel.
Style/medium: deliberately coarse Minecraft Java 16x16 pixel art, built from large hard-edged square logical cells about 1/16 of canvas width; flat muted medium tones and stepped edges. No high-resolution microdetail, hairlines, tiny miniature painting or antialiased fringe.
Composition/framing: One short incomplete fragment about 2 logical cells thick and 4–7 cells long, aiming 14–28 opaque center-sampled cells. End well before spanning the face. Edge contact is OPTIONAL; never lengthen it merely to touch an edge. At most one little associated branch or interior notch. The colored structure remains small and quiet in a tiled wall. No complete seam, whole-face network, emblem or multiple unrelated elements.
Materials/textures: medium charcoal-gray films close to stone, one tiny subdued violet-gray group within, rare dull pyrite only if legible; no jet black. Use two close medium physical values grouped INSIDE the mineral, subdued against mid-gray stone. The shape is legible because of coarse grouping, NOT darker centers, bright outlines, pale rails or high saturation. Mineral cells mostly opaque; background fully clear, no blanket fade.
Constraints: exactly one square 1:1 PNG at least 1024x1024, one untouched mineral-only overlay with true alpha, hard pixel clusters, no host pixels, no text, watermark, border or label.
Avoid: coal's shallow thick horizontal bench, black blotch, purple ribbon, fracture network; full-width band, jet-black center, bright halo, confetti, smooth gradients, glow, shadow, haze, realistic painting.
disposition: Retained unchanged as first pattern within category; active human review
